caption: Right after install the overview shows 2 orders and US$1,449.90 in sales, with cost coverage at 0 of 2 and both orders marked incomplete.
The app reads the cost from the Shopify product page: with a cost per item of US$310, Shopify shows a profit of $389.95 and a margin of 55.7%.
After a reload the Orders screen shows a margin per order, 55.7% and 47.3%, 3 minutes 20 seconds after we pressed Install.
The Reports screen shows revenue of US$1,449.90 and an overall margin of 51.4%, with no cost rules set up.
Shopify shows "No plan selected" under Billing for the app, so nothing was charged. Our test store owner name is covered.
